question: An Indian firm whose turnover is less than ₹ ______ crore is not subject to corporate tax as on November 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An Indian firm whose turnover **is less than ₹ 1 crore** is not subject to corporate tax as on November 2020.
 
• Corporate tax is the tax imposed** by the Government of India** on the net income or profit that corporate enterprises make from their businesses.
